The '''Ojom system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Its main planet was the frozen ocean world of [[Ojom/Legends|Ojom]], populated by the four-armed [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisks]]. Like other Deep Core systems, the Ojom system was probably abandoned after the [[Imperial Reunification]] in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]].<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
